explication: Fabro is a graph-driven software-agent orchestration product: engineers define workflows, start and supervise runs, then inspect changes and execution evidence. The CLI and web UI reach the server API; server run handling admits a pinned graph and dispatches work to Petri, whose worker executes stages with model, sandbox, and human-intervention capabilities. Durable run records and projected stage events support observability, artifacts, and lifecycle controls. The README documents broader graph, routing, sandbox, checkpoint, and API features; unsampled implementation wiring is represented only where repository paths and excerpts support it.
